player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I stopped the exploration prematurely after returning to the Billiard room, assuming all rooms were visited. I did not verify if the current room's unvisited neighbors (specifically the 'west' direction from the Billiard room, which I had not explored yet) contained new rooms. Next time, upon returning to a previously visited room, I will explicitly check all available directions for that room against my current graph. If any direction leads to a node not yet in the "nodes" list, I will continue moving in that direction. I will only output "DONE" when I have confirmed that all reachable neighbors of the current room are already in the graph and no new rooms can be discovered.
